title: Blockbuster could have bought Netflix for $50 million
caption:
In 2000, Netflix offered to sell itself to Blockbuster for $50 million.
Blockbuster said no. Ten years later it filed for bankruptcy.
Today Netflix is worth about {cap:NFLX*1}.
comment: Would you have bought Netflix for $50 million in 2000? 👇
sources: Marc Randolph, That Will Never Work (2019): the $50M offer
Netflix market value: Yahoo Finance, at render time

scenes.say: In two thousand, Netflix offered to sell itself to Blockbuster.
Ten years later, Blockbuster filed for bankruptcy.
The costliest word in business... is no.
